rule.read: through-the-lens probe >= 0.8 and lens top-5 >= 0.5 at some layer before the answer digit's layer, while the full-residual probe >= 0.9 there
rule.write: at the layer of the read peak, his swap or the J++ part of the change (gain <= 2) switches >= 0.5 of what the whole-state patch switches at that layer, with the random part <= 0.10
rule.a: in J-space: read holds and write holds
rule.b: readable, not used: read holds, write fails
rule.c: routes around J-space: through-the-lens < 0.5 at every layer before the answer while the full residual >= 0.9 at some layer, and write fails
rule.d: not represented: the full-residual probe < 0.5 at every layer before the answer
